units.summary: Adds a test helper that builds a head with N series of in-order samples for benchmarks. It is test-only and does not affect production.
units.headline: Adds benchmark helper that builds a head with N series
units.reason: Test-only helper with no production effect.

units.summary: Adds a benchmark for CompactSelectedSeries that selects different fractions of 100k series. The DB is rebuilt each iteration, with the timer stopped. Test-only.
units.headline: Adds benchmark for compacting a selected fraction of series
units.reason: New benchmark only; cannot affect production.

units.summary: Adds a public API that writes the given series into per-chunk-range blocks and evicts them from the head without moving HeadMinTime. Series with OOO data are skipped. Concurrent appends are guarded by an appendID watermark, but only when isolation is enabled. It records triggered, failed and duration metrics.
units.headline: New CompactSelectedSeries writes chosen series to blocks, then evicts them
units.reason: New public API that persists blocks and evicts head data; it holds cmtx.
focus: With isolation disabled, an append that lands between the block write and eviction is lost
Failed counter goes up for errors returned after the triggered counter is incremented
An error after some blocks are written leaves those blocks on disk while the series stay in the head (duplicate data)

units.summary: Adds a happy-path test that checks eviction, the selected-series hint, the unchanged HeadMinTime and the metrics.
units.headline: Adds happy-path test for CompactSelectedSeries

units.summary: Adds a test that nil or empty refs is a no-op: no blocks are written and the triggered counter stays at zero.
units.headline: Adds test that empty refs is a no-op

units.summary: Adds a test that a series spanning two chunk ranges produces two blocks, each with the selected-series hint.
units.headline: Adds test for one block per chunk range
